name: Copper/Gold Ratio ROC — Long GLD Strategy
description: Macro risk-off strategy that goes long GLD (gold ETF) when the copper/gold futures ratio is falling sharply. Uses HG (copper) and GC (gold) reference futures with NoAdjustment continuation to compute the ratio. Signal: 60-day ROC of the copper/gold ratio below -10%. When the ratio drops hard (risk-off environment), the strategy enters a 100% long GLD position. Exits when the ROC reverts above -10%. Daily recheck with hold_until for state persistence.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio ROC — Long GLD Strategy
# Signal: Go long GLD when the copper/gold ratio 60-day ROC < -10%
# Rationale: A sharply falling Cu/Au ratio signals risk-off conditions,
#            which historically favors gold as a safe-haven asset.
#
# Data: HG (copper) and GC (gold) reference futures, NoAdjustment
# Position: 100% equity when long, flat otherwise

# --- Primary Data Source (GLD) ---
src = market_data_source()()

# --- Reference Futures: Copper (HG) ---
hg_ref = reference_futures(ticker="HG")()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_ref.o, hg_ref.h, hg_ref.l, hg_ref.c, hg_ref.v, hg_ref.oi, hg_ref.s)

# --- Reference Futures: Gold (GC) ---
gc_ref = reference_futures(ticker="GC")()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_ref.o, gc_ref.h, gc_ref.l, gc_ref.c, gc_ref.v, gc_ref.oi, gc_ref.s)

# Forward-fill to handle weekends/holidays in cross-asset context
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# --- 60-Day Rate of Change on the Ratio ---
# roc returns decimal: -10% = -0.10
roc_60d = roc(period=60)(cu_au_ratio)

# --- Signal Logic ---
# Enter long GLD when ratio ROC falls below -10% (risk-off regime)
# Exit when ratio ROC reverts above -10%
enter_signal = roc_60d < -0.10
exit_signal = roc_60d >= -0.10

# Persist the signal state with hold_until
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# --- Execution ---
# rollover_policy required by validator when futures_continuation is present
# GLD is the traded asset (equity ETF), but reference futures need this
rollover_policy()(active=gc_cont.s)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# 100% of equity when long
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
